text: Controllers should not clear an aircraft for a visual approach when the RVR is less than 800 meters in UK. If a pilot requests a visual approach when the RVR is less than 800 meters, controllers should inform the pilot that this type of approach is unavailable and requests the pilot's intention. Question. Under what condition can a pilot make a visual approach?
